sources.title: US Army, EdgeRunner Develop Military AI Model That Cuts Errors by Up to 37%
sources.snippet: EdgeRunner AI and the US Army developed EdgeRunner-Camo, a military LLM that cuts errors by up to 37% and runs locally on tactical hardware.
